reviewViews.status: Repeatable owner-photo comparison directions, manually fitted; not calibrated cameras or dimensional validation. Compare clean geometry, not wear or photographed lighting.

views.name: drive-front
views.note: Check inserted media depth, closed lever clearance, flush lamps and fascia seams.

views.name: keyboard-board
views.note: Bottom lid and controller removed as in the photo; check board tongue, socket, traces and rounded sheet tabs.

views.name: keyboard-controller
views.note: Separate narrow controller; clean component construction and approximate placement, not an electrical reconstruction.

views.name: keyboard-cable
views.note: Incoming lead, round bush, bent support and shield clamp; the owner's photo shows these removed from the shell.

views.name: keyboard-plug
views.note: Asymmetric housing, fasteners and offset cable outlet; cable route outside the crop is omitted.

views.name: monitor-profile
views.note: Compare bezel return, curved glass and shell joint. Hidden monitor electronics remain reference-based.

assemblies.title: Case cover and hardware
assemblies.note: Owner confirms 1 mm painted bent sheet. Return lips, transverse stiffeners, vent inserts and rear rail follow specimen photos; bend radii/placement estimated.

assemblies.title: W/M motherboard
assemblies.note: Owner component faces now available; current package placement still follows the W drawing and needs full specimen calibration.

assemblies.title: Display-controller board
assemblies.note: 39 visible packages and component placement from this specimen, including SAB8275P, three UL6516D memories and the wound component. Nominal packages/photo scaling; no exact schematic-revision equivalence claimed.

assemblies.title: Drive adapters and ribbon
assemblies.note: Owner board, sockets and latch; 26/34-contact interface, estimated route and outline.

assemblies.title: Disk drives
assemblies.note: Owner mechanisms, plates and new underside photos; folded 1 mm carrier, large spindle rotors and access windows. Nominal envelope/travel and small dimensions remain provisional.

assemblies.title: Keyboard
assemblies.note: Owner photos and supplied measurements; hidden geometry and unidentified EPROM contents remain provisional.

assemblies.title: PSU cover and fan
assemblies.note: Visible exterior follows owner photos. PSU electronics are not reconstructed; fan speed illustrative.

assemblies.title: Monitor exterior
assemblies.note: Owner photographs and measured stand ring; other local dimensions estimated.

assemblies.title: Monitor internals
assemblies.note: Another K7222.25; exact electronics and hidden dimensions in this specimen unconfirmed.

assemblies.title: System exterior
assemblies.note: Owner rear-panel and enclosure photographs; local dimensions estimated.

annotations.title: Keyboard contact PCB
annotations.dimensions: Underside routing follows visible paths; no verified electrical netlist.

annotations.title: CRT deflection yoke
annotations.dimensions: Position, clamp and winding dimensions estimated; not confirmed on this specimen.

annotations.title: Monitor stand ring
annotations.dimensions: 174 mm OD × 167 mm ID × 5 mm. Physical print/fit unverified.

annotations.title: Rear connectors
annotations.dimensions: Socket outlines follow photos; contact spacing and hidden depths estimated.

annotations.title: Read/write head carriage
annotations.dimensions: 96-tpi reference travel; specimen drive suffix and hidden mechanism dimensions unverified.

annotations.title: Crossed fan retainers
annotations.dimensions: Crossed straps and cushioning observed; dimensions photo-estimated.

annotations.title: 05-330-0024 drive adapter
annotations.dimensions: Black 34-way drive socket, pale 26-way ribbon connector and retaining latch. Board outline and routing estimated.

annotations.title: PSU cover access grommets
annotations.dimensions: Two dark access grommets observed. Shield interior remains unverified.

annotations.title: Display board: solder side
annotations.dimensions: Solder side faces up; components underneath. Exact revision and local dimensions unconfirmed.

annotations.title: U8272 on W/M main board
annotations.dimensions: A44 follows the W placement drawing. Component-side owner photo available; complete position calibration remains pending.

annotations.title: Folded cover stiffeners
annotations.dimensions: Two channels run across the width; local dimensions estimated.

interior.drive: Owner specimens: Robotron K5601 / TEAC 15532064-00A and Ratan assembly / TEAC 15532092-00A; FD-55 suffix unverified
interior.note: Drive envelopes are documented. Drive mechanisms and rear plates now follow owner photos; the nominal envelope remains a reference. Owner October 13 photos establish cover stiffeners, fan retainers, PSU cover and brown drive adapters. W/M motherboard follows the original placement drawing; display controller uses October 14 component-side photos for 39 IC positions, three memories, upright capacitors and a wound component. The 1 mm enclosures and carrier windows preserve views of internal geometry. Local dimensions and exact revision match remain provisional.
